milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate toward and visually observe the magenta glazed terracotta block. The block is placed at spawn-relative coordinates (0, 0, 10). The player needs to be within 5 blocks and facing the block (within 60° tolerance), which models 'the player can see the target block'. The sandbox confirmed the block is clearly visible and identifiable at this range (agent had it in view by step 10 at ~5 blocks distance).
